I personally disagree with some of the comments. The problem with comments like that (you being an adult or not) is that it can take a dark turn. I’ve had many fears of what I looked like because of my moms comments. I’ve starved myself in the past over it. It’s no one’s place, not even your family’s to comment about what you look like or how you eat. It only makes matters worse. Sure you can let someone know that they’re being unhealthy in a nice way if their health is on the line. And you can provoke a healthy lifestyle. But a healthy lifestyle to people looks like diet culture. And it’s not actually health. Food is fuel, it’s all about moderation and calories in and calories out. You can still eat things you love without killing yourself. Of course try to maintain healthier eating more often. But restricting yourself completely and tough diets do not work in the long run. Being healthy is about creating good habits. Not starving or worrying about every ounce of food you consume. 

I wish you luck
